question: What role does the will of śakti play in bondage and liberation?
premises: Bondage and liberation are opposed states.
The will of śakti is a determining power.
There is no doubt about this determination.
inference: Bondage and liberation depend on the will of śakti, without doubt.
plain_english: O fair one, bondage and liberation are by the will of śakti; there is no doubt.
